basic_details.job_title: FCS&CA Lower Divisional Clerk Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Directorate of Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs (FCS&CA), Aizawl, Mizoram, has invited applications for 8 posts of Lower Divisional Clerk (LDC) (Provisional Employee) under Advt No. A.12026/7/2025-DTE(FCS&CA)ESTT. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 12 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Cash. Last date to pay the fee: 12 December 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: HSSLC from a recognized institution; Diploma in Computer Application Semester-I / Certificate Course on Computer Application or above from a recognized institution; typing speed of 30 words per minute; working knowledge of Mizo language at least Middle School level.
qualification.details: Qualification: HSSLC from recognized institution; Diploma in Computer Application Semester-I / Certificate Course on Computer Application or above from recognized institutions by All India Council for Education (AICTE), or any institution recognized by the Central or State Governments/UT Administration under the Union of India; Typing speed of 30 words per minute; Working knowledge of Mizo language at least Middle School level Age limit: 18 to 35 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: As laid down in Mizoram Govt O.M No.A.11019/15/2024-P&AR(GSW) dt. 24.09.2025 | Other conditions: | Working knowledge of Mizo language at least Middle School level

exam_pattern.details: Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour for persons with benchmarked disabilities in each paper Skill Test is a practical test; minimum 36 marks needed to qualify

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the department website fcsca.mizoram.gov.in.
Fill in the Common Application Form and affix a passport size photo.
Attach attested photocopies of date of birth proof, community certificate, qualification and experience documents.
Submit the application at the Establishment Branch, 1st Floor, Treasury Square, during office hours from 13.11.2026 to 12.12.2026.
Pay Rs. 150/- (ST/SC/OBC) or Rs. 200 (General) when submitting.
Bring 3 passport size photographs along with the application.
important_instructions: Guidelines and Syllabus can be downloaded from the department website False information leads to punishment as per law and withdrawal of benefits availed

content_sections.heading: Key Points
content_sections.text: Last date: 12 December 2026 Vacancies: 8 How to apply: Offline, by post or in person as the notification says Fee: ST/SC/OBC: Rs. 150; General: Rs. 200 Pay: Rs. 16,920 Age limit: 18 to 35 years (as on 1 January 2026) Place: Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department, Mizoram

content_sections.heading: FCS&CA Lower Divisional Clerk (LDC) (Provisional Employee) Recruitment 2026 - Overview

rows.directorate_of_food_civil_supplies_consu: Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department, Mizoram

HSSLC from a recognized institution; Diploma in Computer Application Semester-I / Certificate Course on Computer Application or above from a recognized institution; typing speed of 30 words per minute; working knowledge of Mizo language at least Middle School level.
Establishment Branch, Directorate of Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs, 1st Floor, Treasury Square, Aizawl, Mizoram - 796001

content_sections.heading: FCS&CA Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. A.12026/7/2025-DTE(FCS&CA)ESTT gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download FCS&CA notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: HSSLC from recognized institution; Diploma in Computer Application Semester-I / Certificate Course on Computer Application or above from recognized institutions by All India Council for Education (AICTE), or any institution recognized by the Central or State Governments/UT Administration under the Union of India; Typing speed of 30 words per minute; Working knowledge of Mizo language at least Middle School level Age limit: 18 to 35 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: As laid down in Mizoram Govt O.M No.A.11019/15/2024-P&AR(GSW) dt. 24.09.2025 Other conditions: Working knowledge of Mizo language at least Middle School level

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for FCS&CA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates below 30 words per minute in the typing test cannot appear in the written examination Candidates failing the Skill Test cannot appear for the personal interview

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Posts to be filled on Provisional Employee basis

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Cash. Last date to pay the fee: 12 December 2026.

rows.event: Last Date for Submission of Application

content_sections.heading: How Will FCS&CA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Typing Test (qualifying) Written Examination (Paper I and Paper II, 400 marks) Skill Test (qualifying) Personal Interview Typing Test in a computer laboratory: qualifying only, no marks; minimum 30 words per minute Written Examination: Paper I (200 marks) and Paper II (200 marks), grand total 400 Skill Test in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint: 3 questions, 30 marks, 30 minutes each Skill Test minimum 36 marks across the skills; qualifying only, marks not added to final merit

content_sections.heading: FCS&CA Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour for persons with benchmarked disabilities in each paper Skill Test is a practical test; minimum 36 marks needed to qualify

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Attested photocopy of Birth Certificate or HSLC or Aadhaar for date of birth Self-attested photocopy of SC/ST/OBC community document Attested photocopies of educational and other qualifications 3 passport size photographs, plus one affixed on the form Certificate by Head of Department (government servants only)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for FCS&CA Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the department website fcsca.mizoram.gov.in. Fill in the Common Application Form and affix a passport size photo. Attach attested photocopies of date of birth proof, community certificate, qualification and experience documents. Submit the application at the Establishment Branch, 1st Floor, Treasury Square, during office hours from 13.11.2026 to 12.12.2026. Pay Rs. 150/- (ST/SC/OBC) or Rs. 200 (General) when submitting. Bring 3 passport size photographs along with the application.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Guidelines and Syllabus can be downloaded from the department website False information leads to punishment as per law and withdrawal of benefits availed

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for FCS&CA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 12 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in FCS&CA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies for Lower Divisional Clerk (LDC) (Provisional Employee).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for FCS&CA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Common Application Form on pages 3-4 of this PDF; also downloadable from fcsca.mizoram.gov.in) and send it to Establishment Branch, Directorate of Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs, 1st Floor, Treasury Square, Aizawl, Mizoram - 796001, by by hand at the establishment branch during office hours, to reach by 12 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: ST/SC/OBC: Rs. 150. General: Rs. 200.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: As laid down in Mizoram Govt O.M No.A.11019/15/2024-P&AR(GSW) dt. 24.09.2025.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: HSSLC from a recognized institution; Diploma in Computer Application Semester-I / Certificate Course on Computer Application or above from a recognized institution; typing speed of 30 words per minute; working knowledge of Mizo language at least Middle School level.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Working knowledge of Mizo language at least Middle School level.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates below 30 words per minute in the typing test cannot appear in the written examination. Candidates failing the Skill Test cannot appear for the personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Typing Test (qualifying). Written Examination (Paper I and Paper II, 400 marks). Skill Test (qualifying). Personal Interview.
